instruction: Navigate to the page about renewing a driver's license in Virginia

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Virginia DMV homepage to the license renewal page. Evaluator checks if the final URL matches the expected pattern for renewal information pages. Uses existing getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree address bar
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly performs regex pattern matching to verify navigation completion
Expected URL pattern '^https://(www\.)?dmv\.virginia\.gov/licenses-ids/license/renewing' is semantically correct for Virginia DMV license renewal pages
Complete coverage: instruction requires navigation to renewal page, evaluator verifies URL matches renewal page pattern
Edge cases handled: pattern accepts both with/without 'www' prefix, getter has error handling for missing accessibility tree
Runtime feasibility confirmed: getter can access accessibility tree, metric performs straightforward regex matching
